standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of unramified morphisms through the diagonal being locally of finite type and quasi-separated, or through the corresponding inertia condition
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 8429-8433)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces unramifiedness to a property of the diagonal, which behaves well under base change and composition.

standard_prerequisites.name: The corresponding permanence statement for the diagonal of a composition of morphisms of algebraic spaces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 8436-8440) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the composition step after base change to a presentation.

core_obligations: Base change: unramifiedness is stated through a property of the diagonal, and the diagonal of a base change is the base change of the diagonal, so the property is preserved (proof lines 8429-8435)
Composition: choose a smooth presentation of the middle stack, so that the composites become morphisms of algebraic spaces and the corresponding statement for those applies (proof lines 8436-8445)
proof_roadmap: 把 unramified 翻译成对 Δ_f 的条件；基变换后 Δ 就是原来 Δ 的基变换，故基变换保持。
复合：取中间栈的满光滑展示，化为代数空间上对应命题，再用基变换回推。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the property of being unramified for a morphism of algebraic stacks is preserved under base change and under composition (author lemma at source lines 8419-8426, label lemma-permanence-unramified). The proof (source lines 8428-8447) reformulates unramifiedness as a property of the diagonal, which makes the base change case immediate because the diagonal of a base change is a base change of the diagonal, and proves the composition case by passing to a smooth presentation (proof lines 8429-8445). The reformulation through the diagonal and the presentation argument for the composite are the content. H2.
